title: How Compliant is Sepsis Treatment? An Expert-Guided Neuro-symbolic Pipeline for Generating Clinical Compliance Insights
abstract: arXiv:2608.13617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verifying whether clinical care follows evidence-based protocols is a natural neuro-symbolic problem, yet the safety-critical setting defeats either paradigm alone. We present an expert-guided pipeline that constrains a large language model strictly to semantic normalization, mapping messy drug and microbiology strings onto a fixed clinical vocabulary, while a Sugeno fuzzy inference system reasons over the normalized events. The fuzzy layer encodes eight Surviving Sepsis Campaign bundle rules and replaces binary judgments with graded scores in [0,1]. Applied to 2,438 MIMIC-IV v3.1 sepsis episodes, it surfaces antibiotic timing as the most critical breakdown (mean 0.24, 13% within one hour), Hour-1 underperformance (mean 36.7%), a 51% elevated-lactate drop-off, and descriptive differences in ICU stay across compliance groups (3.8 versus 5.1 days).

translated_title: 脓毒症治疗的依从性如何？一个专家引导的神经符号管道用于生成临床依从性洞察
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13617v1 公告类型：新 摘要：验证临床护理是否遵循基于证据的协议是一个自然的神经符号问题，然而安全关键的设置单独使用任一范式都无法解决。我们提出了一个专家引导的管道，该管道将大型语言模型严格限制在语义规范化上，将混乱的药物和微生物学字符串映射到固定的临床词汇表上，而 Sugeno 模糊推理系统则对规范化事件进行推理。模糊层编码了八条拯救脓毒症运动捆绑规则，并用 [0,1] 范围内的分级评分取代二元判断。应用于 2,438 例 MIMIC-IV v3.1 脓毒症病例，它揭示了抗生素时机是最关键的失效点（平均值 0.24，13% 在一小时内），第 1 小时表现不佳（平均值 36.7%），51% 的乳酸升高下降，以及不同依从性组在 ICU 住院时间上的描述性差异（3.8 天对 5.1 天）。
tldr: 本文提出一种专家引导的神经符号管道，结合大型语言模型和模糊推理系统，用于评估脓毒症治疗依从性，并识别出抗生素时机和早期干预中的关键不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an expert-guided neuro-symbolic pipeline combining LLM and fuzzy inference to assess sepsis treatment compliance, identifying critical gaps in antibiotic timing and early intervention.
